entry.name: jit.fx.tr.zoomfade
entry.description: jit.fx.tr.zoomfade performs a zoom and fade based transition between the input textures. Motionblur can be optionally enabled.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output dims to input
attributes.description: Adapt output dims to input (default = 1). When enabled the output dimensions will match the leftmost input dimensions.

attributes.name: amt
attributes.digest: Transition amount
attributes.description: The amount of the transition in 0-1 range. 0 fully displays the first input texture and 1 the second.
